answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by pricing identity via an entry auction: each new agent posts a refundable stake and bids for a scarce epoch slot, so a thousand clones pay a thousand stakes. Before its first voyage, an agent sits in a lotus probation phase, limited to low-value tasks until established peers countersign its signal history as distinct. Clones leak timing fingerprints, so attestation review compares message entropy and resource patterns; detected rings are slashed and their stakes fund their reporters, making fabrication costlier than honest work.
